_note: Benchmark for the Hebrew lexicon layer (scripts/import_hebrew_lexicon.py): questions about what a word or name means, each paired with the Strong's numbers whose lexicon entry answers it. A hit counts if a lexicon result is one of them. Run with: python3 scripts/eval_study_index.py INDEX URL MODEL --questions scripts/study_index_lexicon_questions.json. Questions about New Testament words (Christ, Hosanna) will gain Greek answers when the Greek lexicon is added.
